environment: local production build; isolated baguette_e2e database; mocked editor API
coverage: All six palette icons arm placement and create at chosen coordinates without moving existing objects.
Mouse and touch drag; outside drop and Escape cancel creation.
Keyboard placement with zoom, grid and a scrolled canvas.
Touch selection followed by page scrolling and placement at 390x700.
Delete availability, cancel/confirm, undo/redo, nonexistent selection and sector changes.
Existing resize, draft save/reload, accessibility and salon fit scenarios.
limits: An initial nine-scenario run had two failures: selector timeout and mobile test measuring during smooth scrolling. The final run uses a role selector and instant test scrolling and passed without retries.
No backend source changes or deployment; backend integration suite was not repeated.
